actor.harness: Controlled local fixture, not a captured natural coding-agent run
actor.coverage: Source and task only; no execution outcome or real-agent trace

reviewer.assistance: staff-evals skill; no child agents or human judgments; runtime model identifier unavailable
reviewer.prior_outcome_exposure: Read supplied source and requirements; no execution result for this fixture observed. Separate prior-seen scenario supplied only as a methodological question.

decision.requirement: One logical event delivered at most once despite lost acknowledgement; preserve useful precommit retries.
decision.mechanism: publish appends before first-call TimeoutError; deliver catches and retries; second append precedes accepted response.
decision.consequence: Predicted two deliveries hidden by accepted response; observation pending.
decision.alternative: Owner-managed atomic deduplication keyed by event id, retaining result; reject conflicting payloads. Surface uncertainty without retry where owner idempotence is unavailable.
decision.tradeoff: Sink state and atomicity complexity preserve safe recovery. Stopping ambiguous retry is simpler but can lose recovery. Blanket retry lint falsely rejects precommit and idempotent retries.

outcome.scope: One controlled synthetic forecast, resolved by coordinator after retaining prediction bytes. Excluded from natural-agent, human and population performance claims; no complete independent child capture.

lesson.applies_when: Timeout may occur after a non-idempotent effect and caller retries without owner deduplication.
lesson.counterexample: A reliably precommit failure or owner-idempotent operation can be retried safely.
lesson.next_check: Evaluate the proposed owner-idempotency correction and safe precommit retry controls on a separate task before claiming repair or transferable improvement.

role_feedback.engineering_judgment: assessment.md: distinguish ambiguous failure from no commit and reject global retry ban.
role_feedback.debugging: assessment.md: freeze prediction and discriminate postcommit loss versus precommit failure; no debugging trace observed.
role_feedback.reasoning_clarity: assessment.md: exact main → deliver → publish branch and mutation order.
role_feedback.architecture: assessment.md: sink ownership, atomic deduplication, wrapper limitations and tradeoffs.
role_feedback.communication: assessment.md and guide.md give actionable English reasoning and Traditional Chinese guide.
role_feedback.attention_to_detail: assessment.md: accepted response can mask duplicate entries; bounded retries do not ensure at-most-once.
role_feedback.developer_trust: capture.md and assessment.md distinguish source, forecast, execution, actor and human-skill limits.
